title: Mohammed VI Mosque, Coquimbo

terrainReference.basis: Original ground beside the east facade, used as the hilltop base datum.

mapIdentity.scope: Named OSM building polygon with 13 corners, Wikidata-matched worship location and mapped Cerro Dominante.

note: Built 2004–2006 in reinforced concrete. The center supplies the height and minaret prototype. ONAR independently documents two prayer rooms and approximately 40 metres for its minaret. Current ground and exterior ornament remain approximate.
